answer: Escrow bond plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. An applicant locks 600 credits for 20 epochs and publishes its referrer, with a kernel record tying it to one task. No velvet waiver exists. The public graph exposes one funder's many accounts as a plume of referrals; a proven peer dispute slashes the sponsor too. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 600 = 600,000 credits. An honest agent pays 600 once and earns undiluted rewards.
